embed_handoff: <Figure name="FftCostGrowth" alt="A log-scale ledger compares N squared direct complex-product slots with one-half N log two N radix-two twiddle slots at powers of two from eight through one thousand twenty-four, while a separate empty runtime strip says to measure the machine-dependent crossover." caption="Structural operation counts predict different growth; they do not supply a universal wall-clock crossover." />
